item.title: shairport-sync: 5.5.2 -> 5.6, nqptp: 1.2.8 -> 1.2.9
item.description:
• shairport-sync: 5.5.2 -> 5.6
  • nqptp: 1.2.8 -> 1.2.9

I'm not sure what to make of the upgrade order in both release notes. Is that order critical??? What happens if you just update both and restart both?

You should update and install NQPTP first, then update and install Shairport Sync. Then, restart NQPTP and Shairport Sync, in that order.

I'm not sure we really have a way to orchestrate this order.

item.description:
zoneminder: 1.36.38 -> 1.36.39+git20260703_cfac136 + fix CVE-2026-102296

ZoneMinder has quietly released version 1.36.39 under 1.36.x series to fix a number of security fixes. However, because NixOS unstable/26.11 has already moved to 1.38.x series and 1.36.x is now under "best-effort security fixes" ^1, this will likely be the last update I get to do for 1.36.x in NixOS 26.05 before it goes EoL in Dec 2026. So I've decided to go ahead and bring in the tip of release-1.36 branch, which contains a few more security fixes, without waiting for another release.

For "changelog", see:

Before merging, ensure that this backport is acceptable for the release.

Even as a non-committer, if you find that it is not acceptable, leave a comment.

[!TIP] If you maintain all packages touched by this pull request, and they are all located under pkgs/by-name/*, you can comment @NixOS/nixpkgs-merge-bot merge to automatically merge this PR using the nixpkgs-merge-bot.
